messages:
Sam (AE): FYI - HelioMed just pushed: they need a PO and signed concession by Fri COB or they walk from the POC. Ask list: dedicated pool in 10 days, KMS import support, and a temporary egress waiver. Can we escalate?
Priya (SE): I can put together a crisp tech one-pager. KMS import is only possible for Private deployments; for Dedicated we can do BYOK via Cloud KMS but not raw HSM import. Need their qps and average tokens to size.
Tomas (Eng): Ops can reallocate capacity to meet a 10-day window if leadership approves emergency allocation. Without that, standard provisioning is ~3 weeks. We need a signed PO before we begin capacity reassign.
Avery (Security): They'll also need SOC2, network peering diagram, and KMS attestation language. SOC2 link: https://redwood.example/soc2.pdf. We can provide a redacted pentest summary, but HSM attestation isn't feasible fast.
Sam (AE): Marcus - what's our go/no-go on concessions if this is a strategic close?
Marcus (VP Sales): We can approve a 3-month egress waiver and up to 15% ACV discount if SE confirms mitigation so we don't take outsized infra losses. Provide costs.
Priya (SE): Cost mitigations: prefix KV caching, recommend quantized model (8-bit), and a small reserved burst pool. That should cut infra by ~25-35% depending on traffic. Need expected qps/tokens.
Sam (AE): Customer responded: peak 90 qps, avg 300 tokens/call.
Tomas (Eng): With 90 qps and 300 tokens avg, plan requires ~5 GPUs for steady state to hit p99 < 300ms on the chosen model. Emergency allocation -> possible in ~10 days. Ops signoff required.
Priya (SE): Drafting one-pager now with perf table + fallback plan. Will include cost comparisons reserved vs burst and quantized variant impact.
FinanceBot: Note: any egress waiver must be documented in SOW with rollback terms; finance needs the concession in writing before we start provisioning.
Legal (Counsel): Also confirm we can't promise changes to key custodianship without a formal risk review. Draft SOW clause ready, will post here.
Sam (AE): Priya - please drop the one-pager into this thread by 3pm PT, leadership wants to review ahead of their 4pm sync.
Priya (SE): Uploaded one-pager: https://drive.redwood/heliomed-onepager - includes sizing, fallback quantized model, KV caching, perf sims, and required customer artifacts (PO + network info).
Marcus (VP Sales): Good. Sam, get the PO. If they sign, I will greenlight emergency reallocation contingent on Finance + Legal SOW signoff.
Sam (AE): Customer emailed: "We will sign immediately if Redwood confirms dedicated pool in 10 days and 3-month egress waiver." They attached a PO template.
FinanceBot: Received PO draft. Finance requires signed concession language and ACV approval before processing.
Tomas (Eng): Ops will prepare runbook. Emergency allocation may affect internal dev queues - calling out as a risk.
Priya (SE): Adding rollback plan and perf regression checklist to runbook.
Legal (Counsel): Posted concession language: "Egress waiver applies to POC-only environment for 3 months from provisioning date; normal egress applies thereafter unless a written amendment is executed."
Marcus (VP Sales): I'll raise this on leadership call. Sam, append the SOW concession to the PO and cc me when you send to Finance.
Sam (AE): Done. Sent PO + SOW draft to finance@redwood and cc'd Marcus.
FinanceBot: Finance ack'd receipt and initiated expedited review. Required approvals: FP&A + Revenue Ops. Estimated timeline: 6 hours.
Tomas (Eng): Once finance confirms, I'll open the ops ticket and begin reallocation steps.
Priya (SE): I'll standby for final config items - be ready to approve model variant and caching flags.
Avery (Security): Added checklist: SOC2, network peering diagram, minimal data retention policy, KMS integration steps. Sharing with Legal.
Legal (Counsel): Clarified KMS language: we can support BYOK; HSM import requires Private deployment and additional attestation. Noted in SOW.
Sam (AE): Customer replied: "Signing now." PO attached.
FinanceBot: Finance approved the concession and PO; revenue ops processed the order.
Marcus (VP Sales): Greenlighted. Tomas, start the emergency reallocation. Keep the risk callouts and update leadership after provisioning begins.
Tomas (Eng): Ops ticket created #40321. Deployment ETA ~9 days given current cluster load. Runbook uploaded to ops: https://ops.redwood/tickets/40321/runbook.
Priya (SE): Final note - performance tests queued post-provisioning. I'll run canary tests and validate p99 SLA before customer cutover.
Sam (AE): Closing loop: Emberwell (HelioMed) signed PO, leadership approved concession, ops started provisioning. Keeping this thread as SOT for exec updates.
Marcus (VP Sales): Closing — great job team.
Avery (Security): Post-provisioning: schedule KMS audit and provide audit logs within SLA window.
Sam (AE): Final internal action: ensure SOW is filed and Finance has the concession on record. I'll post a 1-paragraph exec summary to leadership channel once infra is live.
